meta.method: Exact match of normalised dictionary glosses against hand-written accept/near gloss sets per concept; see the script docstring.
meta.list_provenance: All three lists were typed in from the analyst's knowledge of the published lists, not downloaded; counts verified (207/100/65). Diff against Concepticon before freezing.

status_values.covered: a dictionary gloss expresses the concept in the right word class
status_values.partial: only a hyponym, related word or other word class is glossed; human ruling needed

caveats: Glosses are the wiki's English; most are single words with no sense notes.
'covered' says a word exists, not that its grammar or sense range is known.
tier 'canon' = the row cites at least one game-text or in-game-book source; 'semi-canon' = only Prima guide, Imperial Library list, press or game data.
corpus_hover_gloss_only lists dragon-language strings that wiki editors glossed with the concept word in dialogue; fan-level evidence.

concepts.note: canon 'hi' is glossed 'you' with no number stated
canon 'nok' is glossed 'lie' with a wiki remark that it covers both 'lie down' and 'tell a lie'
canon 'bo' is the verb 'fly'; no insect word
tree/wood colexification is common cross-linguistically; a human must rule
canon 'luv' is glossed 'tear' (sense unstated); 'vaaz' is 'tear, rip', expressly not lacrimal
canon 'mal' is glossed 'little'; size or quantity is not stated
no lexical exponent; composable from NOT + WANT if the grammar allows
one canon copula stands for three primes
no dedicated existential attested in the dictionary

supplementary_lexicon_statistics.note: Descriptive statistics of canon spelling used to set forge defaults. Lengths are in letters; neighbours are spellings one letter substitution, insertion or deletion away.

zipf_length_frequency.basis: dictionary spellings that occur as tokens in canon, non-duplicate, non-name corpus texts
